label: Town of Mount Holly
header:
# Town of Mount Holly municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 15; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Mount Holly (official website), Select Board page: lists the three selectboard members as Mark Turco (Chair), Jeff Chase, and Diana Garrow, elected to three-year terms with one expiring every year
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): carries no Mount Holly roster (it directs readers to contact the town clerk)
Town of Mount Holly (official website), Town Office page: lists Carol Garrow-Woolley as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Carol Garrow-Woolley as Mount Holly's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Carol A. Garrow-Woolley as Mount Holly's town clerk
Town of Mount Holly, Select Board special meeting minutes, May 20, 2026: the Select Board voted unanimously to appoint Marc Miller as Treasurer, to complete the term until March 2027

Town of Mount Holly, Select Board special meeting minutes, April 29, 2026: announces the resignation of Liz Karle as Town Treasurer and that the Select Board would appoint a new Treasurer to complete the term; Karle, the elected treasurer named in the Guide, has departed and is not recorded

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Elizabeth Karle as Mount Holly's town treasurer (superseded by her April 2026 resignation)
Town of Mount Holly (official website), Board of Listers page: states the position of Lister is an elected office and lists the three listers as Ann Hansen, Tiffany Austin, and Mary Surething
Town of Mount Holly, Select Board regular meeting minutes, March 10, 2026: the minutes welcome Tiffany Austin as a newly elected Lister
Town of Mount Holly (official website), Auditors page: states each auditor is elected to serve a three-year term and lists the three auditors as Lori Norton, Tiffany Norton, and Christine Pratt
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (one moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Mount Holly justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Diana Garrow, David Johnson, Millicent Johnson, Robert Herbst, Marc Miller, Brigid Sullivan, and Linda Miller.
